hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/codex/hook-adapter.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f" --event SessionStart; fi; exit 0
f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/codex/hook-adapter.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f" --event PreToolUse; fi; exit 0
f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/codex/hook-adapter.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f" --event PostToolUse; fi; exit 0
f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/codex/hook-adapter.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f" --event PreCompact; fi; exit 0
f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/codex/hook-adapter.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f" --event Stop; fi; exit 0
